_doctrine: 13-phase Wall Street cycle. Phase is JORDAN'S call (editorial). Until he calls it, phase='Awaiting Jordan's call' and phase_source='awaiting'. Score + trend are facts and always present; phase_suggestion is the auto/brain advisory. next_move is the FORWARD prediction (brain consensus) — where the phase goes next; current phase stays the anchor.

next_move.reasoning: The coil structure with 0% move rate over 7 days demands HOLD as the skilled default — Disbelief is the adjacent rung the market would enter if risk-on signals (DXY weakness, BTC dom fade) break the coil upward, but no breaker has fired yet.
next_move.brains_agree: Partial — both point toward Disbelief as the next phase, but the analyst hedges with HOLD conviction citing ambiguous leg direction while the narrative writer frames it as a more confident risk-on accumulation setup.
next_move.confirmed_if: BTC funding drops below 0.001% with CVD turning positive and VIX retreating below 14 — genuine Disbelief-to-Hope transition with risk-on follow-through.
next_move.invalidated_if: VIX spikes above 20 with gold breaking $2,800 and BTC funding flipping negative — confirms this is Anxiety/Complacency chop masking underlying risk-off, not Disbelief base.
